question.text: What is the observed response distribution within each declared group?
question.population_or_system: the 18 observed study units in distribution.csv
question.comparison_or_exposure: declared groups shown separately without an inferential contrast

estimands.population_or_system: the 18 observed study units in distribution.csv
estimands.contrast_or_exposure: each declared group separately; no between-group contrast
estimands.summary_measure: empirical distribution with group median and interquartile range
estimands.adjustment_or_aggregation: no weighting or covariate adjustment; summaries are calculated within group
estimands.missing_data_policy: rows with missing group or response are excluded and counted; the example fixture has none

claims.statement: The figure describes every observed response and the median and interquartile range within each declared group.
claims.not_claimed: The groups differ statistically or causally.

primary: one response value and one declared group for each included study unit

panels.question: How are observed responses distributed within each group?

encoding.geometry: jittered raw points with median and interquartile-range summary
encoding.position: declared group on x and observed response on y
encoding.color: one stable accessible color per declared group
encoding.scale_and_limits: linear scale spanning all observed responses with padding

statistics.test_or_model: not-applicable: no inferential test is performed
statistics.multiplicity: not-applicable: no hypothesis tests are performed
statistics.n_definition: number of included study units in each group

panels.unique_contribution: shows the full observed distribution without replacing raw values by a summary alone
known_risks: descriptive summaries do not establish a population difference

data_integrity.missingness: the example fixture contains no missing observation_id, group, or value
data_integrity.aggregation: raw rows remain visible; median and interquartile range are calculated within declared group

limitations: the contract makes no inferential or causal comparison

visual_system.emphasis: raw observations first, descriptive summary second

color_semantics.group: stable across raw points and summary marks

review_risks.risk: coincident points may be visually hidden
review_risks.mitigation: use deterministic bounded jitter and verify all 18 rows in the analysis table

acceptance: all 18 included rows appear once in analysis-table.csv and as raw marks
group medians and interquartile ranges reproduce the analysis table
SVG, PDF, and PNG match the declared physical size and PNG DPI
the final SVG has editable text and no clipping
